info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Cancellation API allows businesses to efficiently manage and cancel logistics shipments. This endpoint enables users to revoke previously scheduled shipments, facilitating smoother operations and inventory management. Typical consumers include logistics managers and supply chain coordinators who need to address shipment changes or customer requests promptly. Through this API, companies can maintain accurate shipping records and improve operational agility in their logistics processes.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a specific shipment by its identifier. Once canceled, the shipment will no longer be processed or delivered.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a shipment by providing the necessary cancellation details in JSON format.

200.description: The shipment cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: Represents the request body for cancelling shipments through the DELETE operation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.title: Shipment Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the shipment being canceled.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the shipment after the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Human-readable message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the cancellation operation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a shipment operation.
